successCriteria.description: `BaseEntity` in `src/shared/types/leave.types.ts` is a type alias (`export type BaseEntity = { id: string; createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date }`) — not an interface. Verified by reading the file and confirming the `type` keyword is present and the `interface` keyword is absent.

The test file at `tests/unit/shared/types/leave.types.spec.ts` is renamed to `tests/unit/shared/types/leave.types.test.ts`. The file contents are unchanged. Verified by confirming the old path does not exist and the new path does, and that the test file content is identical to the original.

constraints: The `BaseEntity` type alias must preserve the exact same shape as the original interface: `{ id: string; createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date }`. No fields may be added, removed, or have their types changed.

The barrel file `src/shared/types/index.ts` must continue to re-export `BaseEntity` as a type (`export type { BaseEntity } from './leave.types'`). The existing `export type` syntax already works for both interfaces and type aliases, so no change is needed in the barrel file — but the re-export must remain functional after the change.
outOfScope: Adding, removing, or modifying any enum values (LeaveRequestStatus, LeaveType, AuditAction) — only the BaseEntity keyword change and file rename are in scope.
Modifying the test file contents — the rename is purely a filesystem operation; the test assertions, imports, and describe/it blocks must remain identical.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `BaseEntity` type alias must be structurally identical to the original interface so that any future consumer that imports `BaseEntity` (e.g., `Employee`, `LeavePolicy`, `LeaveBalance`, `LeaveRequest`, `AuditLog` entities) can extend or intersect with it without breakage. The shape `{ id: string; createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date }` must not change.
